contexts.text: To gather stalks for straw () = to find some scientific truth... For a stalk = such truth as is accommodated to what is scientific... The reason a stalk = such truth, is that what is meant is the stem at the top of which is the seed; and seeds = truths and goods; and thus the stem which is beneath them = a general vessel of truth; thus scientific truth. Explained.
It devoureth them as stubble () = devastation and damnation as of themselves... It is said as stubble, because plenary devastation is signified.
That evils and falsities are dispersed as it were to nothing, is signified by as the dust, and as the driven stubble ().
The house of Esau shall be for stubble (Obadiah. 18). Explained.
Every worker of wickedness shall be stubble (). Explained.
